head: 20f76f9393e3065a7dacdc51c300a19ff179757d
claim: A consumer app installs the shipped @byokit/accounts package, signs in a ChatGPT stand-in account, streams an answer, and gets plain refusals when not offered or not signed in, with the test suite pruned to integration tests and no product code changed

steps.start: a fresh consumer app with no package installed and no account linked
steps: install the shipped @byokit/accounts package into the app
the app links a ChatGPT account by device code: it shows a code and the person approves it
the app reads the account status
the app asks the provider a question and prints the answer it gets back
steps.result: the installed package answers: "ChatGPT is connected." and the answer "You said: Plan my day"

verdicts.seen: I read the single capture record (core-journey.txt). It shows the core journey: 'package: @byokit/accounts@0.34.0', 'status: ChatGPT is connected.', 'streamed: You said: Plan my day', 'not offered: Error: AI account not offered here', and 'no account: ResponseError: ChatGPT isn't signed in yet.' with 'run: node consumer.mjs (exit 0)'. These match the install, sign-in, streaming, and plain-refusal parts of the outcome. The capture does not show the test-suite pruning or that no product code changed, so those parts are unverified here. The outcome names one part, so no per-part list is needed.
